sections.title: What You'll Build
sections.body:
A video platform backend:

- Video upload with chunked uploads (large files)
- Background transcoding (multiple qualities: 360p, 720p, 1080p)
- Adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS)
- CDN integration for global delivery
- Video metadata and search
- View counting and analytics
- Thumbnail generation
- Comment system

sections.title: Key Implementations
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Initialize chunked upload — returns upload_id
- Upload a single chunk
- Reassemble chunks → Transcode → Generate HLS → Upload to S3
- #EXTM3U #EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=800000,RESOLUTION=640x360 360p/playlist.m3u8 #EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=2500000,RESOLUTION=1280x720…
- Track upload progress in Redis
- All chunks received — reassemble and process
- 2. Transcode to multiple qualities
- 3. Generate HLS segments

**Defines:** `init_upload()`, `upload_chunk()`, `process_video()`, `get_video()`

### Chunked Video Upload (For Large Files)

```python
# app/api/upload.py
from fastapi import UploadFile, File, Form
import aiofiles, os

CHUNK_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5MB chunks

@app.post("/videos/upload/init")
async def init_upload(
    filename: str,
    file_size: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    """Initialize chunked upload — returns upload_id"""
    upload_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    total_chunks = (file_size + CHUNK_SIZE - 1) // CHUNK_SIZE

    # Track upload progress in Redis
    await redis_client.hset(f"upload:{upload_id}", mapping={
        "user_id": user.id,
        "filename": filename,
        "file_size": file_size,
        "total_chunks": total_chunks,
        "received_chunks": 0,
        "status": "uploading"
    })
    await redis_client.expire(f"upload:{upload_id}", 86400)

    return {"upload_id": upload_id, "chunk_size": CHUNK_SIZE, "total_chunks": total_chunks}

@app.post("/videos/upload/{upload_id}/chunk/{chunk_number}")
async def upload_chunk(
    upload_id: str,
    chunk_number: int,
    chunk: UploadFile = File(...)
):
    """Upload a single chunk"""
    chunk_dir = f"/tmp/uploads/{upload_id}"
    os.makedirs(chunk_dir, exist_ok=True)

    async with aiofiles.open(f"{chunk_dir}/{chunk_number:06d}", "wb") as f:
        content = await chunk.read()
        await f.write(content)

    received = await redis_client.hincrby(f"upload:{upload_id}", "received_chunks", 1)
    total = int(await redis_client.hget(f"upload:{upload_id}", "total_chunks"))

    if received >= total:
        # All chunks received — reassemble and process
        from app.tasks.video_tasks import process_video
        process_video.delay(upload_id)
        return {"status": "processing", "message": "All chunks received, processing..."}

    return {"status": "uploading", "received": received, "total": total}
```

### Background Video Transcoding (Celery + FFmpeg)

```python
# app/tasks/video_tasks.py
from celery import shared_task
import subprocess, os

@shared_task(bind=True, max_retries=2, time_limit=3600)
def process_video(self, upload_id: str):
    """Reassemble chunks → Transcode → Generate HLS → Upload to S3"""

    # 1. Reassemble chunks
    chunk_dir = f"/tmp/uploads/{upload_id}"
    raw_path = f"/tmp/videos/{upload_id}_raw.mp4"

    with open(raw_path, "wb") as output:
        for chunk_file in sorted(os.listdir(chunk_dir)):
            with open(f"{chunk_dir}/{chunk_file}", "rb") as chunk:
                output.write(chunk.read())

    # 2. Transcode to multiple qualities
    qualities = {
        "360p":  {"resolution": "640x360",   "bitrate": "800k"},
        "720p":  {"resolution": "1280x720",  "bitrate": "2500k"},
        "1080p": {"resolution": "1920x1080", "bitrate": "5000k"},
    }

    output_dir = f"/tmp/videos/{upload_id}"
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    for quality, params in qualities.items():
        output_path = f"{output_dir}/{quality}.mp4"
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-i", raw_path,
            "-vf", f"scale={params['resolution']}",
            "-b:v", params["bitrate"],
            "-c:v", "libx264",
            "-c:a", "aac",
            "-preset", "medium",
            output_path
        ]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
        self.update_state(state="PROGRESS", meta={"quality": quality, "status": "transcoded"})

    # 3. Generate HLS segments
    for quality in qualities:
        generate_hls(f"{output_dir}/{quality}.mp4", f"{output_dir}/hls/{quality}")

    # 4. Generate thumbnail
    thumbnail_path = f"{output_dir}/thumbnail.jpg"
    subprocess.run([
        "ffmpeg", "-i", raw_path, "-ss", "00:00:05",
        "-vframes", "1", "-q:v", "2", thumbnail_path
    ], check=True)

    # 5. Upload all artifacts to S3
    s3_base = f"videos/{upload_id}"
    upload_to_s3(output_dir, s3_base)

    # 6. Update database
    update_video_status(upload_id, "ready", {
        "qualities": list(qualities.keys()),
        "hls_url": f"https://cdn.app.com/{s3_base}/hls/master.m3u8",
        "thumbnail_url": f"https://cdn.app.com/{s3_base}/thumbnail.jpg",
    })

    # 7. Cleanup temp files
    import shutil
    shutil.rmtree(chunk_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(output_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    os.remove(raw_path)
```

### Video Streaming (HLS Adaptive Bitrate)

```python
# HLS = HTTP Live Streaming
# Master playlist tells player which quality options exist
# Player auto-switches based on network speed

# master.m3u8 (generated by FFmpeg)
"""
#EXTM3U
#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=800000,RESOLUTION=640x360
360p/playlist.m3u8
#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=2500000,RESOLUTION=1280x720
720p/playlist.m3u8
#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=5000000,RESOLUTION=1920x1080
1080p/playlist.m3u8
"""

# API endpoint to get video info + streaming URLs
@app.get("/videos/{video_id}")
async def get_video(video_id: str, user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    video = await db.get_video(video_id)

    # Increment view count (async, don't block response)
    from app.tasks.analytics_tasks import increment_view
    increment_view.delay(video_id, user.id)

    return {
        "id": video_id,
        "title": video["title"],
        "description": video["description"],
        "duration": video["duration"],
        "thumbnail_url": video["thumbnail_url"],
        "stream_url": video["hls_url"],  # HLS master playlist
        "views": video["view_count"],
        "uploaded_by": video["uploader"],
        "created_at": video["created_at"],
    }
```
